name: serverlessrepo
description: The AWS Serverless Application Repository makes it easy for developers and enterprises to quickly find and deploy serverless applications in the AWS Cloud.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates an application, optionally including an AWS SAM file to create the first application version in the same call

options.name: --author
options.description: The name of the author publishing the app.Minimum length=1.

options.name: --description
options.description: The description of the application.Minimum length=1.

options.name: --home-page-url
options.description: A URL with more information about the application, for example the location of your GitHub repository for the application

options.name: --labels
options.description: Labels to improve discovery of apps in search results.Minimum length=1.

options.name: --license-body
options.description: A local text file that contains the license of the app that matches the spdxLicenseID value of your application.

options.name: --license-url
options.description: A link to the S3 object that contains the license of the app that matches the spdxLicenseID value of your application.Maximum size 5 MBYou can specify only one of licenseBody and licenseUrl; otherwise, an error results

options.name: --name
options.description: The name of the application that you want to publish.Minimum length=1.

options.name: --readme-body
options.description: A local text readme file in Markdown language that contains a more detailed description of the application and how it works.

options.name: --readme-url
options.description: A link to the S3 object in Markdown language that contains a more detailed description of the application and how it works.Maximum size 5 MBYou can specify only one of readmeBody and readmeUrl; otherwise, an error results

options.name: --semantic-version
options.description: The semantic version of the application: https://semver.org/

options.name: --source-code-archive-url
options.description: A link to the S3 object that contains the ZIP archive of the source code for this version of your application.Maximum size 50 MB

options.name: --source-code-url
options.description: A link to a public repository for the source code of your application, for example the URL of a specific GitHub commit

options.name: --spdx-license-id
options.description: A valid identifier from https://spdx.org/licenses/

options.name: --template-body
options.description: The local raw packaged AWS SAM template file of your application.

options.name: --template-url
options.description: A link to the S3 object containing the packaged AWS SAM template of your application.You can specify only one of templateBody and templateUrl; otherwise an error results

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
